description: Local-only image palette extractor: one-click professional color cards with HEX and ratio annotations, plus CSS/SCSS/Tailwind/JSON export. No Python required.
config.title: HuePick
cmd.pickFromActiveFile: HuePick: Generate color card for current image
cmd.pickFromExplorer: HuePick: Generate color cards for this image/folder
cmd.pickFromFolder: HuePick: Select a folder to batch generate color cards…
cfg.numColors: Number of dominant colors extracted per color card.
cfg.cropBlackBars: Automatically crop the top/bottom black bars of movie screenshots (no effect on artwork or illustrations).
cfg.outputSuffix: Suffix inserted into the output color card file name.
cfg.outputToSourceDir: Output color cards next to the source image; when disabled, a dialog asks for an output directory.
cfg.template: Color card template: landscape 1920×1080 / portrait 1080×1920 / square 1080×1080 / custom.
cfg.customWidth: Custom canvas width (effective when template is custom).
cfg.customHeight: Custom canvas height (effective when template is custom).
cfg.theme: Color card theme: dark / light (affects background, text and separator colors).
cfg.exportFormats: Palette files exported alongside the color card (CSS variables / SCSS / Tailwind / JSON).
cfg.exportHarmony: Whether exported palette files include harmony schemes generated from the dominant color (complementary / analogous / triadic / split-complementary / monochromatic).
